sentences.text: FDA's records show regadenoson is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 71 syringes of regadenoson 0.08 mg/mL, 5 mL at 3.3 a day, providing 21.4 days on hand.
The top-ranked purchasing option is to buy from Astellas Pharma US, Inc., which is also not on FDA's shortage list today.
An alternate manufacturer option is Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. at its Berkeley Heights plant, also not on the shortage list.
A third option is Accord Healthcare Inc., whose label names no plant we could place, and it is not on the shortage list.
